description:
List your organization's most recent PromptGuard security events: what was blocked, redacted, flagged or allowed, with the threat types, confidence, direction, surface, provider and project id. Newest first, at most 50. Filter by decision, threat type, project or a start time. Only PromptGuard's own values are returned: never an event's prompt text, reason, model or names. Read-only.
When to use: To investigate what PromptGuard caught recently, or to check whether a project is seeing attacks.

decision.description: Only events with one of these decisions

since.description: Only events at or after this time (ISO 8601; UTC if no zone)

threat_type.description: Only events of this threat type, e.g. prompt_injection or pii_leak

name: promptguard_list_events
title: List security events
